Recorded claim:
`beginOptimisticCardUpdate()` and `saveDetail()` already render immediately and roll back a failed PUT, but require canonical card identity: `renderBoard()` must map each `board.columns` card to its matching `board.cards` object. Preserve returned `{ email, name }` assignee objects instead of coercing them to text. Column placement is no-points `backlog`, points/no assignee `ready`, assignee `assigned`, while in-progress/review/complete stay preserved. [Task 1]
